---
name: "🚀 Feature Request"
about: Propose a new feature, enhancement, or research extension.
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. E.g., "I'm frustrated when..."

**Describe the Proposed Solution**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Be specific about features, endpoints, or ML changes.

**Phased Deliverable Alignment**
If this feature aligns with our 7-phase plan, please call out which phase it belongs to:
- [ ] Phase 2: Anomaly Detection Layer
- [ ] Phase 3: Explainability Visualisation (SHAP)
- [ ] Phase 4: Live Ingestion (Suricata / Drift)
- [ ] Phase 5: Analyst Triage & Active Learning
- [ ] Phase 6: Multi-tenant SaaS Isolation
- [ ] Phase 7: Research Extensions (UNSW-NB15, ARP Poisoning, Autoencoders)
- [ ] General Enhancement / Refactoring

**Describe Alternatives You've Considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Additional Context**
Add any other context, mockup designs, or dataset schema notes about the feature request here.
